column1: # The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Grezzo's engine on NintendoWare, SDK 8.2.0, update 1.1.0 (v131072). The iOS profile beside this file is unchanged.
# Shared fonts come from the console's firmware: FontStandard, FontNintendoExtension, FontChineseSimplified,
# FontChineseTraditional and FontKorean. --firmware extracts them (without --firmware the game crashes at startup
# because the fallback font lacks U+25A1; see https://github.com/shirai91/nx2android/pull/287). A System font
# (--shared-font) still replaces every shared font but the button icons.
# Played on a Lenovo TB323FU (Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, Adreno 840, Android 16) on 2026-11-15, docked, language
# zh-Hans, with those firmware fonts and no System font. A stretch of play stayed up, drew without a rendering
# fault and did not crash. Earlier runs saw main+0x1c180 SIGSEGV on startup (every release build and most debug
# builds; debug builds occasionally survived when ASLR placed a readable mapping ~4.2 MB past main's end):
# MainCamera_{0}P passes index 0xffff and main+0x1bdb0 indexed the 0x275-entry table at main+0x1bcc898 without
# bounds checking. patches.py now bounds-checks that lookup in-place.
# The present interval stayed 1 (the two NOPs in patches.py). Calm play held 60 fps
# (frame work about 16.6 ms, late on screen 0 of 64). A save survived leaving the app: opening it again
# continued that progress. Loading a new area can still stall for about 100 ms; that is not the interval path.
# Not checked: a full playthrough, traditional Chinese and Korean text.
